question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

176, 218, 228, 291, 280, 364, 332, ?
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

** Difference between two consecutive terms is an increasing multiple of 21.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb6ba35a1b233b4c78fcba1430d2419b79a676cb7d3ad56eddb29ba40c85d1c0.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 3)**
